contents.DefaultText:
Hello everyone!

A new patch; this time with many tweaks and balance changes.

Here's some of the highlights:

Garden Plots:
Crops should now be considerably harder to kill from neglect, which should make them require less micromanagement.
Plants now also give a different amount of yield based on their health, and have more trouble recovering from neglect, in this way rewarding those who take better care of them.

Torch Improvements:
Torches now have different durability based on their wood type, and can have their durability extended or repaired by applying hot tar to them.

Spirit Blessings:
This type of magic now lasts considerably longer, making it a worthy alternative or supplement to enchantments.

Sleep Deprivation:
We have made changes that should make sleepless gameplay considerably harder. Spending enough time without sleep will now cause players to start losing focus and have their actions take longer.


<size=150%>Version EA_0.32:</size>

- Food cards now show the icons of the seasonings applied to them.
- Flavours added or modified by seasonings now appear in green in the card's description.
- Garden Plots now take less damage over time but are also harder to heal.
- Sap Wine is now easier to make.
- Yields now differ by health on all plants.
- Fixed a bug which caused gardens to stop losing hydration.
- Fixed a bug which was causing tilled fields to start with 0% hydration.
- Animal Enclosures now produce less food over time and are harder to fill up with food (animals are expected to graze outside).
- Partridges are now escaping again if their trust is low and they are in an unsecured location.
- Wolf packs are now harder to ambush but are also worse at ambushing.
- Made some tweaks to how Fermentation bins work.
- It is now possible to make Birch Wine from Birch Sap by fermenting it without having to concentrate it first. If you want stronger alcohol you still need to boil it first to make the sugar concentration higher.
- Spirit Blessing duration have been greatly increased.
- Nesting Box can now be dismantled.
- Willow Twigs can no longer be used for clothing.
- Torch Fuel amount now depends on the type of Wood used and can be extended with tar.
- Fixed a bug which caused fragrance effects to apply in the wrong locations.
- Fixed the Campfire bookmark description.
- Secret Grove and Shady grove now have the correct acidity levels.
- Smokehouse now properly displays that it preserves quality and spoilage when drying fresh willow bark.
- Sleep deprivation now lowers focus and adds action penalties.

That's all for now!
See you soon for the next patch!
contents.Text:
大家好！

新更新上线，包含多项调整和平衡性改动。

其中一部分主要改动：

菜园：
作物现在更难因疏于照料而死亡，这将减少玩家对它们的微操。
作物的产量现在会根据其健康度而变，并且更难从疏于照料的状态下恢复，以此奖励那些能更好地照料它们的玩家。

火把改进：
火把的耐久度现在会根据木材类型而有所不同，可以通过涂抹热焦油来延长或修复其耐久。

精魄赐福：
此类魔法现在持续时间更长，使其在实用价值上可以替代或完善附魔。

睡眠不足：
我们新增了一些不休不眠会使游戏更加困难的改动。现在长时间不睡觉会导致角色开始失去专注度，并延长行动时间。


<size=150%>EA_0.32 版本：</size>

- 食物卡现在会显示已添加的调味料的图标。
- 调味料增加或改变的风味现在在卡牌描述中显示为绿色。
- 菜园中的作物随时间推移受到的损伤减少，但也更难治愈。
- 树汁酒现在更容易制作。
- 所有作物的产量现在因健康度而异。
- 修复了导致菜园不再流失水分的bug。
- 修复了导致耕地初始水分含量为 0% 的bug。
- 畜栏现在会随着时间推移产出更少的觅食度，并且更难填满其食物槽（动物被期望在户外觅食）。
- 现在当灰山鹑的信任度低且处于不安全的位置时会再次逃跑了。
- 现在更难伏击狼群，但其伏击能力也下降了。
- 对发酵桶的工作原理进行了一些调整。
- 现在可以无需浓缩直接用桦树汁发酵酿造桦树酒。但如果想要更烈的酒，仍然需要先煮沸浓缩以提高其糖份浓度。
- 精魄赐福的持续时间已大幅增加。
- 巢盒现在可以拆卸了。
- 柳条不再能用于制作衣物。
- 火把的耐久度现在取决于所用木材的类型，可以用焦油延长其耐久。
- 修复了导致香气效果生效在其他地点的bug。
- 修复了营火书签的描述。
- 现在隐秘林地和幽荫林地的土壤酸度正常了。
- 烟熏屋现在可以正确显示其在干燥新鲜柳树皮时保持品质和防止腐烂的效果。
- 睡眠不足现在会降低专注度并增加行动惩罚。

目前就这些了！
下次更新见！
